body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group COO) on the Q4FY25 call (2025-05-28), prompted: "It should start adding revenue in the next, let's say, 10 months to 15 months' time horizon" Metric: OEM fabrication revenue. Target: Revenue starts by ~Mar-Aug 2026. Deadline: 2026-08-31 (quarter). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: PARTLY. Evidence: By Nov-2026 fabrication is under 2% of revenue but 12-15% of new business wins. In Aug-26 OEM supply was still 'in deep discussion ... to now start supplying'; in Nov-26 they were 'working with OEM customers on meaningful revenues'. Some revenue exists (aftermarket and early OEM), so: started, but small and late.
